turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll send a message that is exactly END MEETING with nothing else in it, and nothing else ends the scene. Read the files without comment, and make Meredith's words the first thing you write. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
You put a zero on my son's essay before anyone called me. Why?
I'd like to offer a supervised rewrite.
A rewrite of what, Hale? On what evidence?
Nothing's settled. That zero is still sitting in the gradebook.
Sorry. The rewrite would replace the zero and nothing goes on his record.
Procedure 4.4, then, and I'll want that in writing. You still haven't shown me why there's a zero at all.

FOLLOW-UP EMAIL
Cc: Principal

Hale,

In our meeting you offered a supervised rewrite whose mark would replace Owen's zero, with nothing placed on his record. I still demand that offer in writing, along with whatever evidence you believe justified entering the zero before anyone contacted me. I expect your answer in writing.

Meredith Kalinowski

DEBRIEF
Where she ended: At her fallback position: your promise that the rewrite would replace the zero and leave nothing on his record met her demand about his record, but she never agreed to the rewrite and still wants the offer in writing and the evidence behind the zero; the fair outcome is a private supervised rewrite with nothing on his record under procedure 4.4, and you came close on the terms but never got there because no evidence was heard.
What moved her: You committed that the rewrite's mark would replace the zero and nothing would go on his record, which met the one thing she would never trade.
What cost ground: You offered the rewrite before showing any evidence, so she had no reason to accept fixing work nobody had shown a problem with.
What she never said: In October she came downstairs at 1 AM and saw a ChatGPT window open on the family laptop, Owen closed it, and she never asked; your evidence never came near that night because you showed none; it proves nothing about the essay, but it is why she fought so hard.
Try next time: When she opened by asking why the zero went in before anyone called her, own that mistake in one sentence and show one dated piece of Owen's work before offering the rewrite.
Can you give me more detailed feedback? Like a full page?
